items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So lots of luck, I come in and slap him in the face in his own group on his gig

ctx.x: Who was the gentleman that you actually sat in for?

The guy who led this lamb to the slaughter was… oh, the guy that I didn’t mention was the Beetle, a guy named Steven Henderson, a wonderful stride pianist. But the guy who led me into all this was the guy who wrote the tune that I decided to play in the club. His name was Clarence Profit, and he wrote the tune, Lullaby In Rhythm. So lots of luck, I come in and slap him in the face in his own group on his gig
